```powershell
# Remove any existing virtualenv and create a fresh one
if (Test-Path -Path .venv) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .venv }
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate
```
problems.fix_explanation: The README referenced creating a virtual environment named 'venv' and recommended reuse; project conventions and tests expect a fresh project-local '.venv' directory. Updated instructions use .venv and show how to recreate it on Windows.
